/* fullband.css — DERIVED FROM styles.css. Do not edit by hand.

   THE LINK PAGE'S FULL SCREEN, FOR THE GALLERY AND THE LIBRARY (the owner:
   "why can't the gallery player look like the others? with the same scrubber
   and all?", then "All yes"). Their full screen builds the link page's band,
   its x and its frame (lib/fullbar.js band()), and these are styles.css's own
   rules for them, so the five full screens are written once.

   WHICH RULES. harness/tools/cssgraph.py --band-census opens the Gallery's
   full screen in every state the band has (paused, playing, the speeds open,
   a drag on the scrubber, the controls stepped back, a dark drawing and a
   pale one, a Flip, both themes, a phone and a desk) and records each
   selector that matches inside the full-screen frame. A rule comes here when
   one of its selectors did and none of them matched anything outside the
   frame on the Gallery or the Library, so nothing else on either page is
   restyled. Rules are taken one by one, inside @media too, in their original
   order.

   THE COST IS DUPLICATION, paid for by an assertion: verify_cssplit.py
   regenerates this file and fails if it differs by one byte from what
   styles.css and the recorded census produce. A rule edited in styles.css
   and not re-emitted here is a red suite. */
